CLOSE VERDICT (normal completion gate; Gerrit 1386 MERGED as d394a70529, Verified+1 & LLM-Review+1).

Re-ran the change's own tests against the merged tree (PYTHONPATH=wt-close/src): tests/unit/test_cache_prefix_breakpoint.py + tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py => 28 passed.

AC dispositions:
- AC1 (varying bytes identified + diff cited): done in Phase-1 investigation comment (f81d, (b).2/(c).3).
- AC2 (marked prefix byte-identical across TICKETS): WITHDRAWN as unsatisfiable per Phase-2 re-scope comment (prefix embeds the plan by design; f81d disproved moving plan to user message). Replaced by breakpoint-at-shared-prefix-boundary, verified by test_cache_prefix_breakpoint.py. Box checked to record the documented disposition, not to assert the original unsatisfiable AC.
- AC3 (cross-call cache_read>0): breakpoint relocated to end of byte-stable shared_plan_prefix; verified offline on both providers (commit body); breakpoint stability pinned by tests.
- AC4 (diagnostic flags write-every-call/never-read): cache_write_never_read + warn_if_cache_write_never_read added (usage_log.py, structured_run.py), tested.
- AC5 (cost figures before/after): stated in description measured table + commit.

Closing.
